resources.string: Challenge complete. You can finish the alarm action.
Find the one sheep with its eyes closed.
Tap the numbers in order. Next: %1$d
You are at row %1$d, column %2$d. Reach row %3$d, column %3$d. Available directions are open passages.
Show it again (counts as a miss)
Use the accessible code task (+2 rounds)
Hold your saved NFC tag against the phone.
NFC is unavailable or off. Enable it in Android settings, or use the alternative task.

Listen, tap Record, stay quiet for half a second, then copy the delivery in a normal voice. The experimental score compares rhythm and relative pitch, not the words, your identity or whether you are awake. No speech is uploaded or saved.

After Record, stay quiet for half a second, then speak clearly for two seconds. No need to yell. This measures relative microphone level, not words or calibrated loudness. Recording lasts six seconds and is discarded.
Recording unavailable, interrupted or permission denied. Try again or use the alternative task.

Both Snooze and Dismiss require completion. The sound stays on at a lower level while this screen is open, rises after misses and returns to full level after one minute. Progress survives reopening. System controls and phone access remain available.
Choose a mix. Difficulty changes puzzle size and complexity. At least one task must stay selected.
Save or replace an NFC tag
Tag saved as a hash. This is a wake-up task, not a secure identity check; tags can be copied.
Choose an original robot-voice phrase, or import your own 0.5–6 second PCM WAV (16-bit, mono/stereo, 8–48 kHz, up to 2 MiB). Rehearse before relying on it.
Good morning. The sun is up.
Captain, the pillows have taken over.
Moon control. I am ready for breakfast.

Native JSON packs support typed answers, choices and ordered sequences for all three levels. Maximum 48 KiB. No scripts, web content, network, permissions or file access. Task definitions and voice references are stored with alarms before unlock and included in alarm backups; avoid secrets.
The file could not be read, validated or verified. No existing task was replaced. For voice clips, check format, duration and that speech is audible.
Opens the system dialer. Calling requires your action and may require unlocking. Android lock-screen emergency controls remain available. Leaving this screen restores normal alarm volume.
No dialer is available. Use Android’s lock-screen emergency controls.
The alarm continues. Leaving restores normal volume; progress is retained.
An alarm is ringing. Finish it before previewing the alarm sound.
Microphone permission granted. Tap Record when ready.
Pack validated and selected. Rehearse, then save the alarm.
Reference selected. Rehearse, then save the alarm.
Pack saved and successfully read back.
